name: Stackline
description: A substantial developer-SaaS with a layered interactive hero, language-selectable concept code, cancellable local deployment playground, documentation and usage pricing.

notes.layout: large serif developer hero, interactive layered sculpture, language-selectable code window, pipeline and event demonstrations, environment board, full docs and playground
notes.motion: layer inspection transition, visible cancellable simulation stages, progressive code-window arrival, reduced-motion fallback
notes.interaction: switch and copy concept code, simulate success/failure/cancellation, select environments, calculate sample build and transfer pricing
notes.provenance: Original four-page rebuild with independent code, product behavior, copy and geometric artwork. No reference assets or source included; deployment and billing are local simulations.
